key_insight: BenchmarkHub makes biomedical model evaluations auditable, revealing that answer-grading rules alone can lower measured accuracy by up to 33.1 percentage points and reorder leaderboards.
clinical_relevance: More transparent benchmarking can support scrutiny of healthcare AI claims, but benchmark performance does not establish clinical safety or effectiveness.
method: Open-source platform with browser, command-line and REST API access.
Fixed-seed question sampling, deterministic grading and logging of prompts, replies and tool calls.
Evaluated 12 open-weight models across 15 biomedical and two general benchmarks in five experiments.
evidence_signal: Pooled accuracy ranged from 46.1% to 80.9%; BenchmarkHub scores were lower than published scores in 19 of the 23 available comparisons.
watch_item: Published scores were available for only 23 of 143 tested benchmark–model combinations, limiting external comparisons.
paper_title: BenchmarkHub: an open-source platform for reproducible evaluation of large language models in healthcare
